data.title: Estimaty: Why We Built an AI Tool to Fix UX Project Estimation
data.html_title: Estimaty - The AI Tool Making UI/UX Project Estimation Instant and Effortless
data.html_description: Estimaty is an AI-powered tool that delivers instant, accurate UI/UX project estimates. Built by designers for designers, it streamlines scoping, saves time, and helps you win more clients.
data.description: In the design world, there's an eternal problem - how to quickly and accurately estimate project costs. Every UX designer has faced a situation where a client asks for an estimate 'by tomorrow', while quality design estimation requires time for analysis and reflection.
